units.source_text: 紫夫人自从前年生了一场大病之后，身体很衰弱了。

en.t: Ever since Lady Murasaki fell gravely ill the year before last, her body had grown very weak.

units.source_text: 指不出特别病症，只是一直萎靡困顿。

en.t: No particular illness could be named; she was simply always listless and exhausted.

units.source_text: 虽然并无危险，但已积年累月，总无复健之望，身体就日渐亏损。

en.t: Although there was no immediate danger, the condition had gone on for years, and with no hope of recovery, her body wasted away day by day.

units.source_text: 源氏为此不胜忧愁。

en.t: Genji was overcome with sorrow because of this.

units.source_text: 他觉得即使比她迟死一刻，也不堪其悲痛。

en.t: He felt that even surviving her by a single moment would bring grief too painful to bear.

units.source_text: 但紫夫人自己认为：在这世间已经享尽荣华，心满意足。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki herself thought that she had already enjoyed all the splendor of this world and was content.

units.source_text: 一身已无后顾之忧，不必强求苟延性命了。

en.t: She had no remaining concerns for herself and saw no need to cling stubbornly to life.

units.source_text: 只是辜负了多年来与源氏白头偕老的誓愿，实甚可叹。

en.t: Only the thought that she would fail the long-held vow to grow old together with Genji was truly lamentable.

units.source_text: 因此独自心中悲伤。

en.t: Because of this, she grieved alone in her heart.

units.source_text: 她为了要修后世福德，举办了许多法事，并且恳切地请求源氏主君，

en.t: In order to cultivate merit and blessings for the life to come, she held many Buddhist services and earnestly begged Lord Genji

units.source_text: 让她出家为尼，以遂夙愿，使在今后短暂的在世期间亦得专心修行。

en.t: to let her take vows as a nun, fulfill her long-cherished wish, and devote herself to practice during the short time she had left in this world.

units.source_text: 然而源氏坚不允许。

en.t: However, Genji firmly refused to allow it.

units.source_text: 源氏自己也有出家修行之志，如今紫夫人如此恳切要求，

en.t: Genji himself also wished to renounce the world and practice the Way, and now that Lady Murasaki was asking so earnestly,

units.source_text: 他本想乘机提早和她同入佛道；

en.t: he was inclined to take the opportunity and enter the Buddhist path with her sooner than planned;

units.source_text: 但念一度出家，必须决心绝不过问世事，方可相约在极乐世界同登莲座，永为夫妇。

en.t: but he reflected that once one renounced the world, one had to resolve never again to concern oneself with worldly affairs; only then could they promise to ascend the same lotus seat in the Pure Land and remain husband and wife forever.

units.source_text: 然而，在世修行期间，即使同一山中，亦必远隔溪谷，分居两地，不复互相见面，方能专心修行。

en.t: Yet while practicing in this life, even if they lived on the same mountain, they would have to be separated by valleys, dwell in different places, and no longer see each other in order to devote themselves fully to practice.

units.source_text: 如今夫人病体如此衰弱，已无复健之望，倘欲就此分手，离居异处，实甚难舍。

en.t: Now that her sick body was so frail and there was no hope of recovery, it would be unbearably hard to part from her here and live apart in another place.

units.source_text: 若果如此，则道心惑乱，反而玷污山水清秀之气。

en.t: If that happened, his resolve for the Way would be thrown into confusion and would instead defile the pure spirit of the mountains and waters.

units.source_text: 因此踌躇不决。

en.t: For this reason, he hesitated and could not decide.

units.source_text: 这在思虑疏浅、毅然遁入空门的诸人看来，似乎落后得多了。

en.t: To those who thought shallowly and resolutely withdrew into monastic life, this seemed to fall far behind.

units.source_text: 紫夫人不得源氏主君许可，若独断独行，擅自出家，又觉太过轻率，且亦违背本愿。

en.t: Since Lady Murasaki could not obtain Lord Genji's permission, she felt that acting on her own and taking vows without leave would be far too rash and would also go against her true wish.

units.source_text: 因此对丈夫颇感怨恨。

en.t: Because of this, she felt considerable resentment toward her husband.

units.source_text: 她疑是自身业障深重之故，甚是忧虑。

en.t: She suspected it might be because her own karmic obstacles were so heavy, and she was deeply troubled.
